build: python -m threshold_engine workbook "{out}" --series "Credit card=tests/data/cards_nco_ttm.csv" --series "Mortgage=tests/data/mortgage_nco_ttm.csv" --series "Home equity=tests/data/home_equity_nco_ttm.csv" --series "Other consumer=tests/data/other_consumer_as_filed_nco_ttm.csv" --name "Net charge-off rate (TTM)" --unit "%" --direction higher_is_worse --frequency quarterly --smoothing 1 --floor-at-zero yes --moderate-halfwidth 0.5 --low-step 1.0 --high-z 2.5 --on-the-line worse --percentiles 50 75 90 95 --horizon 4 --min-history 41

steps.title: Build the four-product workbook and open it
steps.how: Run the build command (section 1), then open the file in Excel.
steps.note: Sheets, in order: Thresholds, Assess, Chart, Evidence, Backtest, Glossary, Data, Run. The Glossary count was 33 when first written, from WHAT-IT-DOES.md; the first run found 35, and the document was out of date (two terms added since 6 Oct). Corrected here and there.
